_comment: Named ComfyUI render targets for `pixelmon --server NAME`. Copy this file to servers.json and add your machines. Keys starting with _ are ignored. You can also pass a raw host/URL: `--server 192.168.1.50`. RENDER FARM: pass a comma-list to fan jobs across all of them, e.g. `--server gpubox,titan,local` (dynamic dispatch — faster GPUs do more).
_default_comment: _default = the target used when no --server is passed (and $PIXELMON_SERVER is unset). An alias, host/URL, or comma-list farm. Omit it for 'local'.
_restart_comment: _restart = optional shell commands that restart a server's ComfyUI, by alias. pixelmon-gui runs one when that server is stuck (prompts waiting, nothing running, for 20s) or hasn't answered for 30s — at most once every 3 minutes. Renders waiting on it ride out the restart and are sent again if the server forgot them.
